xmldoc.short_description: Convert data type without changing underlying data.

param_input_item.param_description: a variable: noncomplex, full, numeric scalar or vector.
a character vector: destination numeric class name ('int8', 'int16', 'int32', 'int64', 'uint8', 'uint16', 'uint32', 'uint64', 'single' or 'double').

param_output_item.param_description: result of typecast: X reinterpreted as the requested type.

description.p: typecast reinterprets the bytes of X as the numeric class type without changing the underlying byte pattern.
Unlike cast, the numeric values are not converted: only the class interpretation of the same memory changes. The number of bytes of the input must be a whole multiple of the destination class size.
A column vector yields a column vector, otherwise the result is a row vector.
